5.3.1VennDiagram
A diagram that represents mathematical sets and their relationships is called a Venn
diagram. In a Venn diagram, the sets are shown using circles or closed curves bounded in a
rectangle. The rectangle represents the universal set.
We can represent various set relationships with the help of Venn diagrams.
